title: The Files area in the app: every file in my rooms, with Save
spec: The app agrees to FEATURE_FILE_LIST. ChatSession::list_files sends ListFiles and reads the files frame (Unsupported without the feature; a frame of another length than the answer said closes the session); SignedInSession::list_files (None when not offered). Command::ListFiles; the worker emits Event::Files (Update::Files), or FilesNotOffered. The window's app bar has Files under Chat: Files opens the Files area and asks for the list ('Loading files...'), shows each file as 'name (size)' with 'in <room>' and 'Save <name>' (Command::Save), says 'No files in your rooms yet.' when empty, and 'Refresh files' asks again; Chat returns to the conversation. End to end, a file Alice posted is in Bob's list with its room, size and uploader, and saves byte for byte.
